info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Olivine Jacket Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation and management of detailed catalog entries for the Olivine Jacket. It allows businesses to add essential product information, ensuring accurate representation in the inventory system. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems seeking to maintain updated fashion product catalogs. Use cases include online retailers looking to streamline their product listings and enhance customer experience through detailed information.

post.summary: Create New Details for Olivine Jacket
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new details for the Olivine Jacket, enabling customization and personalization of the product. Utilize this API to input specific attributes and features that enhance the jacket's appeal to customers.
